content_data.meeting_title: Robotic Vision System Architecture Review - Obstacle Detection Module
agenda_items: Discuss migration from ROS1 to ROS2 framework timeline and dependencies
Address integration challenges with the navigation stack
key_decisions: Approved transition to CUDA-accelerated point cloud processing to reduce latency by 40%
Selected TensorRT for model inference optimization over ONNX Runtime based on benchmark results
Decided to refactor sensor calibration module using Eigen library for better performance
technical_blockers: Insufficient GPU memory on current hardware for simultaneous processing of 6 camera streams
Network bandwidth limitations affecting real-time data synchronization across distributed robot fleet
ROS2 compatibility issues with legacy sensor drivers requiring custom bridge implementation
